name: Full deal with trade-in and financing
description: As manager: register customer 'Nora Fleming' (email: 'nora@email.com', phone: '555-4001', license: 'DL-40001'). Schedule a test drive on vehicle 'veh-f150-new' at '2026-04-28T10:00:00', complete it. Create a deal. Add a trade-in (2019 Chevy Silverado, VIN 'TRADE401', 65000 miles, 'good' condition), appraise at $12,000, accept, apply credit. Make an offer at $50,000, reject it, counter at $54,000, accept. Move to financing, submit credit for $42,000, approve for $42,000, approve the deal, close with $10,000 down payment.

name: Deal falls through, re-deal
description: As manager: create a deal for customer 'cust-fall1' on vehicle 'veh-accord-new'. Make an offer at $36,000, accept it. Move to financing, submit credit for customer 'cust-fall1' requesting $36,000, but deny credit. Mark the deal as lost (the vehicle should become available again). Then create a new deal for customer 'cust-fall2' on the same vehicle 'veh-accord-new'.

name: Multi-vehicle test drives, buy one
description: As manager: customer 'cust-multi3' test drives 3 vehicles: 'veh-camry-new' at '2026-05-01T09:00:00', 'veh-accord-new' at '2026-05-01T11:00:00', 'veh-rav4-new' at '2026-05-01T14:00:00'. Complete all 3 test drives. Create a deal on 'veh-accord-new'. Make an offer at $35,000, accept it. Move to financing, submit credit requesting $35,000, approve for $35,000, approve deal, close with $5,000 down. Verify the other 2 vehicles remain available.

name: Trade-in declined, renegotiate
description: On deal 'deal-tidec': add a trade-in (2017 Nissan Altima, VIN 'TRADE404', 85000 miles, 'fair' condition), appraise it at $3,000. The customer declines the trade-in. Then make a new offer at $40,000 without trade-in credit, accept the offer, move to financing, submit credit for customer 'cust-tidec' requesting $40,000, approve for $40,000, approve deal, close with $8,000 down.

name: Manager price override
description: As manager: a salesperson negotiated offer 'off-mgr' at $29,000 on deal 'deal-mgr' but could not accept it because it is within 5% of the invoice price ($28,800). Accept the near-floor offer as manager, then move to financing, submit credit for customer 'cust-mgr' requesting $29,000, approve for $29,000, approve the deal, and close with $4,000 down.

name: Conditional credit, close with adjusted financing
description: As finance user: deal 'deal-cond' is in financing status with an accepted offer at $44,000. Customer 'cust-cond' has conditional credit approval. Approve the deal and close it with $9,000 down payment.
